notes.title: Minor Updates
notes.content:
Noteworthy changes:

White-Room now seems infinite
More autosaves
EQ-ed Triangle sound effect to make the high pitch sound less disgusting
First chase has more feedback
Removed item icons temporarily since they don't work as intended
AlphaBoy is now named EarlyAccessBoy
Added "Safe music" in Puzzle Room
Hopefully fixed Cloud Save Feature of Steam for Win and Linux
Added Trophies


Thanks for reading! 8)
